title: Repair Order Lifecycle, Parts Consumption, Invoicing Integration
key_finding: repair.line model removed in Odoo 19; parts now as stock.move rows with repair_line_type (add/remove/recycle); invoice_method also removed, invoicing is via Sale Order bridge

breaking_changes.impact: Migration must re-map legacy repair.line rows to stock.move with repair_line_type and repair_id
Invoicing now requires a Sale Order; direct repair invoicing no longer available

recycle.description: Extracted part returned to usable stock

invoicing.under_warranty_effect: Sets price_unit=0 on all add-type SO lines; enforced at toggle and at SO line creation
invoicing.qty_delivered_sync: SaleOrderLine._prepare_qty_delivered() checks done repair moves for qty_delivered update

lot_tracking.error: ValidationError raised if lot_id missing at action_repair_done()
lot_tracking.auto_populate: From picking_id.move_ids.lot_ids when exactly one lot present

stock_valuation.double_posting_guard: account_move_line._eligible_for_stock_account() blocked for add-type repair moves already having account_move_id
stock_valuation.is_consuming: stock.move._is_consuming() returns True for add-type repair moves

next_units_suggested: U189 (if stock valuation / COGS deep-dive needed)
U190 (if sale-repair integration or sale_project module needed)
